name: kanagawa-vscode
description: IDE features for the Kanagawa hardware description language: navigation, completion, hover, and more.

languageModelTools.name: kanagawa_lookup_symbol
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find symbol definitions (classes, functions, types) in Kanagawa code
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Looks up symbol definitions by name in the Kanagawa workspace index. Returns matching symbols with their qualified names, file locations, signatures, documentation, and type hints. Use this when the user asks about where something is defined, what a symbol is, or needs to understand a specific Kanagawa declaration. Supports optional scopePath for disambiguation when multiple symbols share the same name.

symbolName.description: The name of the symbol to look up (e.g., 'FIFO', 'processData', 'MyStruct')

scopePath.description: Optional scope path for disambiguation (e.g., ['data.fifo', 'FIFO'] to find members of FIFO)

languageModelTools.name: kanagawa_get_type_members
languageModelTools.userDescription: List methods and fields of a Kanagawa class, struct, or union
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets all members (methods and fields) of a Kanagawa type, class, struct, or union. For templated types like 'FIFO<uint32, 32>', returns members with instantiated signatures where template parameters are substituted. Use this when the user asks what methods are available on a type, what fields a struct has, or needs to explore a type's API.

typeName.description: The type name, may include template arguments (e.g., 'FIFO', 'FIFO<uint32, 16>', 'Vector<T>')

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return

languageModelTools.name: kanagawa_infer_type
languageModelTools.userDescription: Infer the type of an expression at a location in Kanagawa code
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Infers the type of an expression at a specific location in a Kanagawa source file. Handles variable declarations, function return types, member access chains, cast expressions, and template instantiations. Use this when the user asks what type something is, or when you need to determine the type of an expression before looking up its members. Line and character are 1-indexed.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the Kanagawa source file

languageModelTools.name: kanagawa_get_module_exports
languageModelTools.userDescription: List all symbols exported by a Kanagawa module or file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all top-level symbols (functions, classes, structs, etc.) exported by a Kanagawa module or file. Use this when the user asks what's in a module, wants to see the public API of a file, or needs to understand the structure of a Kanagawa source file.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the Kanagawa source file

limit.description: Maximum number of symbols to return

languageModelTools.name: kanagawa_get_imports
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show imports and dependencies of a Kanagawa file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets resolved imports for a Kanagawa file to understand its dependencies. Returns the current module name, list of import declarations with their aliases, and which modules were successfully resolved. Use this when the user asks about file dependencies, wants to understand import relationships, or needs to know what modules are available in scope.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the Kanagawa source file

languageModelTools.name: kanagawa_search_symbols
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search for symbols by name pattern in Kanagawa code
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches for symbols (classes, functions, structs, variables, etc.) by prefix or substring match. Useful for exploring an unfamiliar codebase when you don't know exact symbol names. Can filter by category (class, function, struct, etc.) or limit search to a specific file. Use this when the user wants to find symbols matching a pattern, explore what's available, or locate definitions without knowing exact names.

query.description: Search query - matches symbol names by prefix or substring (case-insensitive, minimum 2 characters)

category.description: Optional: filter by symbol category (class, function, struct, method, member, constant, enum, variable)

filePath.description: Optional: limit search to symbols in this file

limit.description: Maximum number of symbols to return

kanagawa.developerMode.markdownDescription: Enable developer commands for debugging and performance analysis. When enabled, additional commands appear in the Command Palette for parse tree inspection, verbose logging, and performance profiling.

kanagawa.compiler.importPaths.markdownDescription:
Additional search paths for Kanagawa imports. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder.

**Merged** with `kanagawa.config.json` entries (both sources are combined).

kanagawa.compiler.stdlibPath.markdownDescription:
Standard library location. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder.

**Overrides** `kanagawa.config.json` if set here.

kanagawa.index.exclude.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns for files and folders to exclude from indexing. Patterns are matched against paths relative to the workspace folder.

**Merged** with `kanagawa.config.json` entries.

Examples: `**/generated/**`, `**/*.gen.k`, `test_vectors/**`

kanagawa.inlayHints.typeHints.enabled.markdownDescription:
Show inferred type hints for `auto` variable declarations.

Example: `auto x = getValue();` shows `: int32` after `x`.

kanagawa.inlayHints.parameterNames.enabl.markdownDescription:
Show parameter name hints at function call sites.

Example: `process(data, true)` shows `buffer:` and `async:` before arguments.

kanagawa.inlayHints.templateParameterNam.markdownDescription:
Show template parameter name hints at template instantiation sites.

Example: `Vector<int32, 16>` shows `T:` and `N:` before arguments.

kanagawa.signatureHelp.templateParameter.markdownDescription: Show template parameter signature help when typing template arguments (triggered by `<`).

kanagawa.outline.categoryFilter.markdownDescription:
Filter which symbol categories appear in the document outline. Leave empty to show all categories.

Use the command `Kanagawa: Select Outline Categories` for an interactive picker.

kanagawa.outline.modulePrefix.markdownDescription:
Only show symbols whose module path starts with this prefix.

Example: `data.` shows only symbols from `data.*` modules.

kanagawa.typePeek.enabled.markdownDescription:
Show `type: ...` CodeLens above `auto` variable declarations.

Disabled by default since inlay hints provide the same information inline.

kanagawa.performance.debounceDelay.markdownDescription:
Delay (in milliseconds) before processing document changes. Higher values reduce CPU usage during rapid typing but increase latency.

Default: 200ms

kanagawa.performance.memberCacheLimit.markdownDescription:
Maximum number of member resolution results to cache. Higher values improve performance for large workspaces but use more memory.

Default: 500 entries

kanagawa.performance.indexChunkSize.markdownDescription:
Number of files to process in each indexing batch. Higher values speed up initial indexing but may cause UI stuttering.

Default: 10 files per batch

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile:test
